message:
[Page 3] Money: tools, budgets and spend Lena Ortiz owns our tools list: every software seat and vendor, what it costs a year and when it renews. Each team has a budget for the quarter, and Lena tracks what is spent against it. Tool owners are reminded a month before a tool renews. Expenses and purchases go through Spend. People submit their own expenses with a receipt and a category; Lena approves them and marks them paid. Purchases over $2,000 need Krishna's approval. Each person sees their own spend; Lena and Wade see all of it. Time off: people request it, their manager approves or declines, and it is marked taken once the days have passed. Lena keeps everyone's yearly balance. [Page 4] Expense policy Every expense needs a receipt and a category before it can be approved. The categories are Software, Travel, Cloud, Meals, Office, Equipment, Training and Other. Lena Ortiz approves or rejects every submitted expense. Nobody approves their own expense. Team meals are paid up to $40 a person. Expenses are paid with the next payroll once approved. [Page 8] Expense policy (continued) Receipts are kept with the expense. An expense without a receipt waits on the person who submitted it until the receipt is attached. [Page 9] Purchasing policy Purchases are requested in Spend and approved before they are ordered. Purchases over $2,000 need Krishna's approval; Lena approves the rest. A purchase moves from requested to approved, ordered and received. [Page 11] Budgets Each team has a budget per quarter. Spending counts against the budget of the person's team. Tables attached (name, header and row count; the cells are data too): "Expense ID","Date","Employee Email","Merchant","Description","Amount","Category","Receipt","Status","Project Code"
Latest message from Wade Wilson: Set up Spend: Expenses and purchase requests. People submit their own expenses with a receipt and a category, and Lena approves or rejects them and marks them paid. Purchases are requested and approved before they are ordered. Each person sees their own spend, and Lena and Wade see all of it. Renewal requests from Customer contracts arrive here. Its rules, from the policies: - An expense without a receipt waits on the person who submitted it until the receipt is attached. - Lena approves or rejects every submitted expense, and nobody approves their own. - Once approved, an expense is paid with the next payroll and Lena marks it paid. - A purchase over $2,000 waits on Krishna's approval; Lena approves the rest. - A purchase moves from requested to approved, ordered and received. Where it connects to what is already built: - spending counts against the team's budget in Tools and budgets Its rows come from expenses.csv, imported into its first sheet. The file's columns fill plain columns of that sheet (text, dates, amounts, people, choices, steps); a link can't be filled from a file, so a link column there stays empty for imported rows.
